| **Mountain View Yoga Retreat** | Bear Mountain, NY | Vegetarian meals prepared on site | Spa with aromatherapy, hot stone massages | 5‑night retreat, yoga, mindfulness workshops |
| **Sage Yoga & Spa Retreat** | Westchester County, NY | Vegetarian buffet & daily specials | Spa with hydrotherapy, sauna, and massage | 8‑night program, yoga, nutrition seminars |
